test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
Match the words with their closest meanings.

a. obliterate 1. fraudulent

b. entice 2.eradicate

c. hypocritical 3. lure
solution:
The correct answer is **'****a - 2, b - 3, c - 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the words:

 
 
• Obliterate: to remove all signs of something by destroying or covering it completely. (किसी वस्‍तु के सब चिह्नों को मिटा देना (उन्‍हें पूर्णतया नष्‍ट करना या छिपा देना); मिटाना)
 
• **Entice:** to persuade somebody to do something or to go somewhere by offering him/her something nice. (कुछ इनाम या लालच देकर किसी को कुछ करने के लिए मनाना; लुभाना, फुसलाना।)
 
• **Hypocritical: **saying that you have particular moral beliefs but behaving in a way that shows these are not sincere. (पाखंडपूर्ण।)
 
• **Fraudulent: **obtained, done by, or involving deception, especially criminal deception. (धोखाधड़ी, विशेष रूप से आपराधिक धोखे से प्राप्त, किया या शामिल किया गया।)
 
• **Eradicate: **remove or** **destroy completely; put an end to. (पूरी तरह से नष्ट; को खत्म कर दें।)
 
• **Lure: **tempt (a person or animal) to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward. (कुछ करने या कहीं जाने के लिए प्रलोभन (एक व्यक्ति या जानवर), विशेष रूप से किसी प्रकार का इनाम देकर।)
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the correct answer is 'a - 2, b - 3, c - 1.'
